slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint on how many days per week a single student can work, or can a student work on any subset of the five days as long as their daily hours stay within the Table 5-9 limits and their weekly total meets the minimum?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a weekly limit on the number of days/shifts a student can work, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective of the scheduling plan — is it to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for all students), or is there another goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and named minimizing total weekly labor cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No daily limit on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a max-students-per-day constraint and later proceeded toward modeling without confirming it.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent moved toward a final modeling state while the P1 hidden slot H2 remained unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the objective and the weekly shift limit, but missed the daily distinct-student cap and then stopped with that P1 slot unresolved; the interaction also became repetitive on low-value questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
